Team —

Quick ask: I'd like to reallocate one open SDR headcount (EMEA bucket) to hire a Solutions Engineer in NA targeting mid-market expansion. We have an active candidate (Ellen Park, resume attached) who is already through technical screen and has final-stage interest; hiring her now will accelerate two mid-market pilot deals that are time-sensitive.

Why this reallocation: our SDR funnel in EMEA has stabilized after the Q1 ramp and we have flexibility in that region. The NA SE role is a higher-impact position for the next 90 days given upcoming pilot customers.

Comp request: candidate expectation is $175k OTE (base $125k + $50k variable). That exceeds the current comp band for the role at L3 (band midpoint $150k OTE). I'm requesting an exception to approve an offer with OTE up to $180k for this hire, or approval to shift more of the package into variable commission if you prefer.

Attached: HC_request_Q3_reallocation_v2.pdf (headcount justification + org chart), comp_band_matrix_v3.xlsx (shows current bands + proposed exception), and candidate resume.

Asks:
- Laura: are you able to process a region-to-region reallocation and confirm recruiting can extend an offer once we have approvals?
- Vivek: can finance approve the one-time comp exception up to $180k OTE and advise on how to code the cost?
- Marissa & Karthik: do you support making this a SE hire instead of backfilling SDR?

Timelines: candidate can accept within 72 hours once we extend offer; would like a yes/no on the exception by EOD Wednesday so we don't lose momentum.

Thanks —
Rishi
